# ROBUST CODE

> ROBUST CODE S.A.R.L is an engineering-driven software company building custom digital solutions, SaaS platforms, and business automation systems.

ROBUST CODE designs and delivers custom software, CRM/ERP platforms, cybersecurity, payment infrastructure, and digital transformation programs for organizations that need scalable, resilient technology.

## What We Do

- Custom software engineering (web and mobile applications)
- CRM and ERP platforms
- Cybersecurity and payment APIs (Stripe, PayPal, Flexpaie)
- Data engineering, architecture, and business intelligence pipelines
- Omnichannel user experience (UX/CX) design
- Brand storytelling and digital content engineering

## Business Units

- RC-CORE: Custom software engineering, CRM/ERP solutions, cybersecurity, and payment APIs. Home of REM and RCM.
- RC-DATA: Data engineering, architecture, and business intelligence pipelines.
- RC-XP: Seamless and immersive omnichannel user experiences, in partnership with Rahlab.
- RC-STUDIO: Brand storytelling and creative digital content engineering, in partnership with Rahlab.

## Products

- REM (Robust Enterprise Management): flagship commercialized enterprise platform for unified operations, finance, and reporting.
- RCM (Robust Customer Management): internal engine for customer intelligence and relationship data.
